parameters.description_en:
Specifies the monitoring dimensions of the resource.

Format: A collection of `key:value` pairs, for example: `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

> A single request supports batch querying up to 50 instances at most.
